name: Barbarian Thane's Grip ends when the Barbarian leaves Ancestry (#9946)
contract: Thane's Grip 803798 is the Ancestry talent entry 11219 (TE 1, eight Ancestry points invested). Its
SPELL_EFFECT_TITAN_GRIP lets the Barbarian wield a two-handed axe, mace or sword in each hand. Switching to
Brutality removes the Ancestry talents, so the second two-hander must leave the off hand, the Titan's Grip
penalty 49152 must end and a two-hander can no longer be equipped there. The main-hand two-hander stays.

steps.label: FIXTURE: dual wield, so only the two-handed grip varies
